content: Tat Kraistna mbaapma wuleingwa njɨmbla wukngwa nyaangɨt ana nat njambɨ ngambugiyowun. Wan kavle vat yiga yetɨngwa vak kwagalalaa God waa apma vat mɨna kwutaa alɨ ngwula. Ngwuk kat tak wanja nyaangɨt tak wukngwa nyaangɨtna. Ngɨni lɨga nyaangɨt mbukiyowun.

Ngu yagu ngwula waa tak ngwuk kat wanja nyaangɨt at nat njambɨ ana ngwuk kat waigowun. Taamba taagaga Godna waagana vat kwilɨnja vak kat ngwuk kat nat njambɨ ana mbukiyowun. Kiyaa nɨmba aywaa laatndi maa God ndi kat sɨga naguga vɨndeya vak kat ana ngwuk kat nat njambɨ bukiyowun.
God wun kat kwondu kwindɨ maa wan tak wukngwa nyaangɨt kwagalaa ngɨni lɨga nyaangɨt ngwuk kat mbukiyowun.
Nat nɨmba tamba God waa vak maawupmba yelavɨka lɨndi. God kwiya apma vat ndi tamba klandi. Godna waagan tamba klandi.
God waa nyaangɨt tamba wuka lɨndi. God nat nda ngɨni kwutndeya vat tamba vɨga lɨndi.

Wundi nɨmba God waa nyaangɨt kat kai waga kwagalanjeyan kupi maawut ngɨni ana sɨkiyandi. Tak Jisas kat kai walaa diwai krosmba kaala nɨmba ya vak vla ndino kai walaa diwai krosmba kaala nɨmba ya vak vla ndino kai walɨnja vak kɨta vatna. Tak Jisas kat njɨka wala nɨmba ya vak vla ndino kai walɨnja vat kɨta vatna.
Kɨpmamba lɨga waatɨga nda vla kɨta vatna. Meik ndalɨndɨ maa kɨgɨnda apma vat wotɨndɨ maa vɨga la nyan kɨga lɨgiyandɨ. God wan vak tɨgandɨ wandɨ, tɨgandɨ.
Wan kɨpma meik ndandɨ maa nɨmbio lɨga yamboy mɨna waatndeyan wan kavle vatna. Ndinyangu wugni vak kat ana woviyaguga lɨgandi. Ndi wan nda kalɨtaa yisolaa yamba tugiyandi.

Ngwuk kɨta mbaapma nɨmba kavle vat ana yigiyangwuk. Vɨlɨganɨn. God waa nyaangɨt kat kai walɨga nɨmba kavle yigyandi waa wawa nyaangɨt ngwuk kat ana wowun. Ngwuk kavle vat ana yigiyangwuk. God ngwuk kat tamba kwunatndɨ.

God ngwuk kat vat sɨmblan ana yigiyandɨ. Ngwuk Godna njɨvwa nɨmamba kwutɨgangwuk. God kat woviyaguga lɨga tak Godna nɨmba kat kwunatɨngwuk. Mbambala nɨmbun kwunatɨgangwuk. Ndi kat woviyaguga lɨngwa vat God tamba vɨndɨ. Ngi kat tɨga God ngwuk kat apma vat yigiyandɨ.
Nɨmamba njɨvwa kwuka God waa nyaangɨt maawupmba yelavɨka nɨmamba kwutaa lɨngwangat ngwuk kat woviyaguga lɨgowun. Apma vat mɨna yiga yetɨngweyan ngwutna maawut tagula vat tɨgiyandɨ.
Ngwuk kwo ke yilɨngwa. Ngwut tagula maawutno lɨga God kwiya nda klaiganɨn waa yelavɨka lɨga nɨmba vla alɨ ngwula.
NGWUK KAT KWUNAKIYOWUN WAA GOD NƗN KAT WANDA VAK

Tak God Ebraham kat wandɨ. Mɨn kat apma vak yigiyowun. Mɨna nyangu nɨma sakwat tɨgiyandi waa God wandɨ Ebraham kat. God kat kwulata lɨga njambwi nyan kai. Wungi kat tɨga God nat njambwi nyana sɨ sɨge yiga ana Ebraham kat wandɨ. Ndɨ avla ndɨna sɨ mɨna sɨge yiga Ebraham kat wandɨ.
Ebraham wan nyaangɨt wutaa ndɨna mbangɨ ana kɨlɨpangɨ yindɨ. Ndɨ woviyaguga kawiga lɨndɨ. Tɨga lɨga Godnanamba klandɨ.
Ndinyangu nɨna vat ndɨ kapma vala. Nɨn kat kwulata njambwi nyana sɨmba sɨge lɨganɨn. Sɨge lɨna vak wuta nɨmba wutaa eylavɨtɨgandi. Ndɨ ana woseka walɨgandɨ waa yelavɨtɨgandi.
God waa nyaangɨt wutaa ndɨ God woseka ana walɨgandɨ waa wanangat wandɨ God. Wungi kat tɨga avla ndɨna sɨ sɨge yindɨ. God nɨn kat kwigiyadɨ luwa. Ana nɨn kat woseka waigandɨ waa yelavɨtɨganɨn.

God ndinyangu kat apma vak yiga kwunakiyowun waa wanda nyaangɨt wutaa maawupmba yelavɨka kwutaa lɨganɨn. Yaiga vak kat ana nɨmamba yelavɨka lɨganɨn. God tak nyaangɨt kwindɨ. Kwo ana kwindɨ. Ndɨna sɨ sɨge yiga kwindɨ. Ngi kat tɨga ana alɨpsɨga woseka wandɨ waa yelavɨtɨganɨn.

Njambɨtna samban ndaiga nɨmbumba taagalaa njambɨt kat kwutaa lɨlɨgandɨ. God nɨn kat kwunakiyowun waa wanda nyaangɨt nɨna maawupmba yelavɨka kwutaa lɨna vak kɨta vatna. Njaambɨt samban kwutaa lɨndeyan wan njaambɨt ana kavle yigiyandɨ. Nɨno wupma. God waa nyaangɨt maawupmba yelavɨka kwutaa lɨneeyan nɨna maawut ana kavle yigiyandɨ. Nɨn nyɨnangwut wuleilaa klanda klaneya vak kat yelavɨka lɨganɨn.

Nɨna njambwi nyan Jisas tat nyinangwut tamba wuleindɨ. Nɨn ndɨna kwupmba wuleigiyanɨn. Judana Hetpris God tɨga kava wuleinda vak vla Jisas nyinangwut wuleindɨ. Wan njɨvwa Jisas kwutɨnda njɨvwa ana njgɨlɨgiyandɨ. Melkisedek walɨnja tamba la nyan Hetprisna njɨvwa klanda vak vla Jisas wan njɨvwa wupma klandɨ.
